description: This Java source file defines the ScreenFactory class, which manages loading, caching, and rendering of screen models in the OFBiz widget framework. It includes methods for parsing XML screen definitions, retrieving screens by location or web context, and rendering referenced screens.

classes.name: ScreenFactory
classes.description: A utility class for managing screen models, including loading from XML files, caching, and rendering in the OFBiz widget framework.

methods.name: isCombinedName
methods.description: Checks if a given combined name string contains a '#' indicating a composite name.

methods.name: getResourceNameFromCombined
methods.description: Extracts the resource location part from a combined name string.

methods.name: getScreenNameFromCombined
methods.description: Extracts the screen name part from a combined name string.

methods.name: getScreenFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelScreen object based on a combined location and screen name.

methods.name: getScreenFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelScreen object given a resource name and screen name.

methods.name: getScreensFromLocation
methods.description: Loads and caches all screens from a specified XML resource location.

methods.name: getScreenFromWebappContext
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelScreen from the web application context, with caching based on webapp name.

methods.name: readScreenDocument
methods.description: Parses an XML Document to create a map of screen names to ModelScreen objects.

methods.name: renderReferencedScreen
methods.description: Renders a referenced screen, handling composite names and loading the screen model.
